name: Dakar
subtitle: Dakar, capital of Senegal: its numbers, a short history and places to see beyond the World Heritage list.

keyPoints.text: Dakar Department numbered 1,278,469 residents in the 2023 census (over 4 million in the wider Dakar Region).

items.label: residents in Dakar Department, 2023 (4.00M in Dakar Region)

blocks.prompt: About how many people lived in the Dakar Department in the 2023 census?

parts.text: 1,278,469 in the central Dakar Department (and 4,004,427 across the five departments of Dakar Region) in the 2023 census by ANSD Sénégal.
